resolutions.reason: Submitting headers are spread-copied once before start. Startup and both cancellation paths use this copy. Polling omits the optional headers argument and therefore calls current sbeAIHeaders. Deferred acknowledgment A-to-B test proves original-owner cancellation, and polling test proves B is denied while cleanup uses A. Server still resolves live principal and checks owner, tenant and permissions.

resolutions.reason: Archive captures input immediately, then invokes owner-keyed navigator.locks.request with default exclusive mode. Fresh list read, expected-version validation and whole-archive write are inside the synchronous lock callback. list checks the captured owner after a queued wait and owner is rechecked before write. Save button awaits completion and never reports early success. Missing locks fail visibly before mutation; there is no unprotected fallback. Shared deterministic mutex/interleaving tests verify version conflict, overlapping new products retention and queued identity change.
tests: Two window saves of the same version conflict instead of silently losing one edit
Two overlapping new products both remain in the private archive
Queued save rechecks ownership and fails visibly when locking is unavailable
